name: infranodus-memory
description: Automatic memory for Claude Code, stored as a knowledge graph in your InfraNodus account: at the end of a session it saves what was learned about the project; at the first prompt of the next one it recalls it, plus a gap the memory doesn't cover yet. On in every project once installed; /infranodus-memory:off stops it for one project.

api_key.title: InfraNodus API key
api_key.description: From https://infranodus.com/api-access. Used by the memory hooks to recall what earlier sessions learned; stored in your system's secure store.

api_base.title: InfraNodus API address (optional)
api_base.description: Leave as is unless you run your own InfraNodus server.

mcp_url.title: InfraNodus MCP address (optional)
mcp_url.description: Leave as is unless you run your own InfraNodus MCP server (e.g. http://localhost:8787/mcp for local testing).

save.title: What to save
save.description: both (the default: learnings about each project, and facts about clients, companies and cases, each in its own memory-<topic> graph), learnings, or memories.

exclude_paths.title: Folders to leave out (optional)
exclude_paths.description: Comma-separated folders or globs where memory never runs, e.g. ~/clients/*, ~/private
